intro: Intro of Settings › Socio access. Socios are the AI agents; mini apps are small apps people build in Socio. "A card in the chat" is the request card the person answers.
reading.title: Heading: per socio (AI agent), whether it may read mini apps for the person without asking first.
reading.help: Help text under the heading of the per-socio choices on Settings › Socio access; socios are the AI agents. "Without a card": without asking on a request card in the chat. Some apps always ask, whatever is chosen here.
reading.label: Accessible name of the choice next to each socio. {{socio}} is the socio's name.
reading.manual: Option: the socio asks on a card each time it wants to read an app.
reading.bypass: Option: the socio may read apps without asking.
reading.auto: Option: an automatic reviewer decides each request. "Auto review" is a feature name.
granted.title: Heading of the list of live accesses the person granted to socios (AI agents).
granted.none: Shown in the list of live accesses when no socio (AI agent) has access to a mini app for the person.
granted.ended: Summary of a collapsed list of ended accesses; {{n}} is how many.
granted.endedLabel: Accessible name of the list of ended accesses.
loadFailed: Error toast when Settings › Socio access could not load its socios' choices and accesses. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
saveFailed: Error toast when saving a socio's choice of whether it may read apps without asking failed. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
endedToast: Toast after the person ended a socio's access to a mini app.
endFailed: Error toast after the confirmation to end a socio's access to a mini app, when ending it failed. Shown only when the server gives no message of its own.
